_meta.note: The sidecar's user-facing copy. Keys are dotted and flat. This file is the fallback for every other locale, so a key missing here surfaces as the key itself — add here first.
_meta.voice: Say what happened, then what the reader can do about it. No exclamation marks, no apologies, no blame. Where a setting would fix it, name the setting.
_meta.verbs: Values may carry fmt verbs (%s, %d). The verb order belongs to the translation — that is why these are messages and not sentences assembled in Go.
